godbolt_skip: Compiler Explorer compiles a single source file with one dxc invocation and shows generated code; it cannot run the second (dxl/-link) step, cannot run dxa -dumpreflection, and exposes no reflection data at all. The symptom is a field of D3D12_SHADER_BUFFER_DESC in the linked container, so no CE link can show it.
summary: Reflection of a lib_6_x library linked to ps_6_0 reported Num Variables: 0 for its cbuffer. Does not reproduce on main (13730886e): dxa -dumpreflection on the linked container shows Num Variables: 2 with both members. Release matrix over all 20 stable releases (harness held fixed, producer varied) shows the defect in v1.6.2106 through v1.7.2212.1 and clean from v1.7.2308 onward; the three older releases predate -link and are invalid probes. At v1.6.2112 the library alone reflects correctly and only the linked output loses the annotation, matching the reporter's analysis. Strong attribution to bf015d2e1 (#5197, 2023-05-10), which is in the 257-commit fix window and is the only commit in history adding the CopyTypeAnnotation call in DxilLinkJob::AddGlobals.
title: Can't get cbuffer's variables from a linked shader
